title: Figure 7: Peltier Junction Heat Pump schematic
description: Schematic of a Peltier junction showing N-Type and P-Type semiconductor blocks bridged by a top "Conductor" labeled "Hot Face" and bottom conductors labeled "Cold Face," with arrows for "Current In" and "Current Out." The caption explains that running current through the device drives thermal energy into the upper conductor, and that the principle also works in reverse to generate voltage. Surrounding text discusses thermoelectric efficiency and using programmable materials to manage heat on spacecraft hulls.
